name: claude-motion-reel-2026
description: A 15-second motion design showreel, rendered entirely from code: deterministic canvas + WebGL2 renderer, sub-frame motion blur, and a procedurally synthesized soundtrack scored to the renderer's own event times.

scripts.render: node tools/events.mjs && node showreel/audio/synth.mjs && node tools/render.mjs
scripts.render:vertical: node tools/events.mjs --format vertical && FORMAT=vertical node showreel/audio/synth.mjs && node tools/render.mjs --format vertical
